certs.name: CERT Polska
certs.about: One of three national CSIRTs under Poland's National Cybersecurity System Act (with CSIRT GOV and CSIRT MON). Handles incidents for citizens, businesses, and most of the .pl space. Runs the national Warning List of phishing domains that Polish ISPs block, the SMS 8080 scam-text channel, and a large portfolio of open-source security tools.
certs.constituency: Citizens, private sector, local government, .pl domain and Polish IP space (except areas covered by CSIRT GOV and CSIRT MON)

services.name: Incident reporting form
services.desc: Online form for anyone in Poland to report phishing, fraud, malware or attacks.

services.name: SMS 8080
services.desc: Forward suspicious text messages free of charge to 8080. Reports feed SMS blocking by mobile operators.

services.name: Dangerous Websites Warning List
services.desc: 24/7-maintained list of phishing and scam domains. Polish ISPs block the domains at the DNS level. Entries stay on the list for six months.

services.name: Warning List data files
services.desc: Free downloads in text, JSON, XML, hosts, AdBlock, MikroTik and RPZ formats. CERT Polska recommends refreshing every 5 minutes.

services.name: Warning List check
services.desc: Tests whether your current connection is protected by the Warning List.

services.name: Warning List tools
services.desc: Scripts for deploying the list on Active Directory DNS, Pi-hole and other resolvers.

services.name: n6
services.desc: Free platform that sends organisations security events matched to their IP ranges and domains, from sinkholes, MWDB, Artemis and partners.

services.name: Artemis scanner
services.desc: Modular vulnerability scanner. CERT Polska runs it at scale against public-sector assets and privately reports findings to administrators.

services.name: MWDB
services.desc: Community malware repository with REST API. A free account gives access to samples and extracted configs.

services.name: Open-source portfolio
services.desc: mwdb-core, Karton, mquery (YARA search), malduck, DRAKVUF Sandbox, n6, Artemis.

services.name: Publications & warnings
services.desc: Threat analyses, vulnerability disclosures and scam campaign warnings in Polish and English.

services.name: Coordinated vulnerability disclosure
services.desc: CVE Numbering Authority. Coordinates vulnerabilities in Polish products and publishes advisories.

services.name: Annual report 2025
services.desc: Published 8 April 2026. Incident statistics, campaigns, and the Warning List in numbers.
